contenders.handicapper_notes: Enters in peak physical condition following consecutive runner-up finishes, including a strong closing second over this track and distance on August 16 behind Skibidi. Ideally drawn in barrier 3 to secure a smothered run before utilizing Moruya's long 400m home straight. Canonical style S.

Progressive four-year-old mare trained on the track by Jamie Stewart. Beaten a nose in a Goulburn BM58 over 1200m two back before finding 1400m slightly too far at Nowra. Perfectly suited dropping back to 1200m on a Soft 5 surface with Brock Ryan in the saddle. Canonical style P.

Racing in career-best form having won two of his last three starts, including a tough victory at Nowra over 1400m on August 10. Carries top weight burden of 62.0kg and an awkward wide gate, but possesses the tactical versatility to overcome it under Erin Ellison. Canonical style S.

Ultimate venue specialist with 15 career placings at Moruya (28: 3-5-7). Flashed late to finish a close third over 1200m here on August 16. Well weighted with apprentice claim relief and gets the right tempo scenario to rattle home out wide. Canonical style S.

Landed a sharp win over 1200m at Cowra earlier this prep and has proven competitive in provincial/country benchmark company. Top regional hoop Brodie Loy takes over the reins from a low draw. Canonical style P.

Returns from an eight-week freshener. Ran a nose second at Nowra in heavy conditions prior to a plain effort at Goulburn. Well drawn in barrier 2 and possesses good early tactical toe to hold an on-pace stalking spot. Canonical style P.
